svg.aria-label: Vat dyeing with indigo: reduce → dip → oxidise
svg.title: Vat dyeing with indigo: reduce → dip → oxidise
svg.desc: Vat dyeing cycle of indigo with sodium dithionite reduction to leuco form and air oxidation
svg.text: Vat dyeing with indigo: reduce → dip → oxidise
Indigo is insoluble, so it cannot dye directly; the –C=O groups are reduced to enolate (–C–O⁻) to give a water-soluble leuco form.
Repeated dip–air cycles build up the shade (ring-dyeing of denim yarn keeps the core white).
